title: refactor(objectql): split registry.ts into section modules by codemod (split 1 of 8), a move with the public exports unchanged
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Part of #33949. This PR is split 1 of 8 under ruling item 1: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`. It also adds the split facade's line ceiling, as ruling item 2 and the ceiling gate from #34103 require. The other seven splits stay open on the card.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:用脚本 `scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs` 把 objectql 的 `registry.ts`(12,577 行)按章节拆成 13 个模块,`registry.ts` 留作转发入口,剩 6,326 行,并按裁决第 2 条给它登记行数上限 6,426(6,326 + 100);对外导出一个不少、类型/值种类不变,只是代码搬家,不改任何行为。
- 为什么改:落实 #33949 裁决第 1 条「热点文件逐个用 codemod 拆分,registry.ts 第一个」。这个文件是并发 PR 冲突最多的地方之一,拆开后各改各的模块。
- 风险与回滚:风险在「搬家是否真的一字不差」。脚本自证两件事:200 个方法体和 127 个顶层声明与 main 上逐字节相同;`registry.ts` 的 68 个导出名与种类不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` 新增的 1 行 facade 与 15 行例外(留在 registry.ts 里没搬的成员及原因);② `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 看转发形态;③ `packages/objectql/src/federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` 的 5 个键改名(唯一改动的测试)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --verify --base $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)`,预期两行都是通过:`byte-identity: 200/200 … identical` 与 `exports-equality: equal`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:Tier H(超过 3,000 行),需要维护者批准合并。

## What changes

`scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs` splits `registry.ts`. It is pass 1 of `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` (the `engine.ts` split), re-targeted at `SchemaRegistry`, with one addition: an exports-equality proof.

- **Facets.** 200 of the 215 class methods move to a facet class in one of 11 section modules. The section anchors are the existing section banners, so each module is one banner's methods. `SchemaRegistry` keeps every member's signature and docblock, and each moved method is a one-call stub: `Facet.name.call(FacetHost.of(this), …)`. `registry-facet-hosts.ts` declares a host per facet and the class installs them in a static block, so a facet reads private state only through its host.
- **Top level.** 127 of the 161 top-level declarations ahead of the class move whole into `registry-top-level.ts`. `registry.ts` re-exports by name every one it exported before.
- **Stays.** 15 methods and 34 top-level declarations stay in `registry.ts`. Each method that stays is a row in `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` `exceptions`, citing #33949 with its stay reason (bare `this`, inferred return type, a parameter that shadows a moved name, a computed name, the constructor). That is the same shape the `engine.ts` split left for its members pass.
- **Path readers.** Four declarations stay in `registry.ts` because a reader looks for them in that file by path: `mergeObjectDefinitions` and `isShareableNamespace` (ADR symbol anchors), `REGISTRY_LOG_LEVELS` (`check:registry-log-declared` and `check:rest-log-declared` read it from `registry.ts`), and `TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` (an ADR-0117 `registry.ts#organization_id` token). They are the script's `PATH_READER_PINS`, so the ADRs and the two gates are untouched.
- **Facade registration.** `scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json` registers `registry.ts` / `SchemaRegistry` as a facade, so `check:facade-delegation-only` holds it to delegation from here on. `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS` in that gate names the file.
- **Line ceiling.** `ceilings` gains `{ file: registry.ts, baseLines: 6326, baseCommit: c27f4ab0d6, maxLines: 6426, ruling: 6897467376 }`. `c27f4ab0d6` is this branch's regeneration commit, the merge of origin/main `f9120b8692` with the split regenerated on it, so the count is measured on the split file. The gate reads `registry.ts: 6326 lines, ceiling 6426 (100 left; ruling 6897467376)`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/objectql` patch, a move only.

### Re-running the split (one command)

The ruling says a split is generated against fresh main right before it is queued. On a branch cut from fresh `origin/main` (with `registry.ts` unsplit), run:

```sh
node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --write
```

It writes the modules, rewrites `registry.ts`, proves byte-identity and exports-equality, and exits non-zero if either proof fails. `--verify --base REF` re-proves a split already on disk, and with no flag the script prints the plan only. Then re-key `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` if its rows moved (the test names the file each row now lives in), and refresh the `exceptions` rows from the plan's stay list.

### Open PRs that touch `registry.ts`

Measured at 2026-11-16T05:51Z over all 62 open PRs, through the paginated REST files list: no open PR other than this one touches `registry.ts`.

Earlier overlaps are all already inside the split. #34036 (+45 / −1) merged at 19:50Z, #34156 (+73 / −7) at 01:46Z, and #34224 (+31 / −2) after that. This head is regenerated on origin/main `f9120b8692`, which contains all three.

## Tests

- **The codemod's self-test**, `node scripts/codemod-split-registry.mjs --self-test`: 74 cases in 7 batteries pass. Six batteries are copied from the engine codemod (stay rules, top-level moves, facets/statics/docblocks, refusals, the byte-identity proof, the import prune). The seventh, exports-equality (Proof 2), has 6 cases: the generated split is equal; and each of these fails: a base export the split drops, a value re-exported as a type only, a new export outside lever (a), a module re-exporting `registry.ts` with `export *`, and a base the checker reads no exports from.
- **objectql**, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 599/599 test files, 13,366/13,366 tests pass, on `b89e3e42b8` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- **Direct dependents** (11 packages: cli, cloud-connection, plugin-audit, plugin-dev, plugin-email, plugin-pinyin-search, plugin-sharing, plugin-webhooks, runtime, service-automation, verify). On `b89e3e42b8`, after the `runtime` and `cli` dependency closures were rebuilt (63/63 tasks), typecheck passes for objectql and all 11 dependents (75/75 tasks). Their tests ran on the earlier split heads `3683e1eb53` and `537121403d`: runtime 605 files, and the cli unit tier (`--project unit`) 423/423 files and 6,010/6,010 tests. They were not re-run on this head, which is a declared narrowing; CI runs them in full.
- **One test changed.** `federated-injected-column-readers.test.ts` keys each reader as `FILE#FUNCTION :: column`. Five keys follow their function to its new file (three to `registry-top-level.ts`, two to `registry-platform-global.ts`). The `organization_id` row stays at `registry.ts`, where `TENANT_SCOPE_INDEX` is pinned. No assertion changed.

The script's blob at this head is still `eb7cc556a0b3`, so the ablation reads the shipped script.

</details>

<details><summary>The split's own proofs on this head (`--verify --base origin/main` at f9120b8692)</summary>

```text
byte-identity: 200/200 moved bodies identical to base (body, parameters, return type, async); 127/127 moved top-level declarations identical to base (leading comments included); registry.ts 12577 -> 6326 lines; undoing the split does rebuild the base byte-for-byte once the 63 import binding(s) only moved text reads are pruned from the base
exports-equality: equal — registry.ts exports 68 name(s) at base (55 value(s), 13 type(s)); the split exports every one, each the same kind, plus 10 generated name(s) (lever (a), the statics route), which no module re-exports with `export *`
```

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The members pass.** The 15 `exceptions` rows are first-pass stays, as on `engine.ts`. A members pass that moves them is a separate card, not this PR.
- **Size.** The diff is about 12,800 lines added and 7,100 removed (+12,829 / −7,105). Almost all of it is moved text that the script proves byte-identical, plus the 3,073-line codemod.
